blue.l1I1IlI1I1llllIl.android:title: How To Use
blue.l1I1IlI1I1llllIl.android:dialogMessage:
To customize the bot from your own account type !bot or view the settings in Blue Mods -> Bot or the Per-Chat menu

From another account:

Enable "Group Self Bot" here in settings and say "Commands" in the same group from the other account.

blue.lIIll11I1lI1111I.android:title: Group Bot
blue.lIIll11I1lI1111I.android:summary: Allows others to modify settings in your built-in bot, and you will respond to group commands. (not recommended)

blue.lIIll11I1lI1111I.android:title: Bot Trigger Permission
blue.lIIll11I1lI1111I.android:summary: If enabled, non-admins can add or delete triggers to the built in bot

blue.lIIll11I1lI1111I.android:title: Anti Spam / Lag Code
blue.lIIll11I1lI1111I.android:summary: Removes people who spam, wipe the chat, or use a lag code.

blue.lIIll11I1lI1111I.android:title: Disallow Noobs
blue.lIIll11I1lI1111I.android:summary: Removes users who join your group if their account age is under a certain amount of days

blue.lllllIIllIl1l11I.android:title: Set Disallow Noobs Age Limit
blue.lllllIIllIl1l11I.android:summary: Set the minimum requirement for account age when joining your group (in days)

blue.lIIll11I1lI1111I.android:title: Anti Empty Picture

blue.lIIll11I1lI1111I.android:title: Anti Long Name
